title: Night desk set
note: A short invented chat. Scored spellings are in the replaced turns. One spelling is only in the kept tail.

messages.content: The set has to be quiet enough for the night desk.
The valve is an ECC83. Bias was set to -1.4 V.
Leave the chassis number as RK-17. Do not stamp it RK-17B.
RK-17 stays. RK-17B is set aside. The hum was not a ground loop; that diagnosis was wrong.
A mica washer is in the tray.
I will button the chassis tomorrow.
